newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit du Nord sees net doubling in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Credit du Nord sees net doubling in 1997.

text.p: French bank Credit du Nord, which is being sold by Paribas to Societe Generale, expects to double net profit in 1997 versus that of 1996, chief executive Philippe Toussaint said on Tuesday.
He was speaking after the group published its 1996 results, including a net profit of 191.1 million francs.
"The first months of the year are precisely in line with our objectives," he told a 1996 results news conference.
"We are very confident that the 1997 result should be double the 1996 result," he said.
Paribas said separately on Tuesday it had signed a deal for the previously announced sale of 100 percent of Credit du Nord to Societe Generale for 2.2 billion francs.
